thin-content.fix: Expand with useful, specific text (services, FAQs, proof)
thin-content.how: Add sections in Elementor; Yoast readability/word count helps.

duplicate-title.how: Edit page → Yoast SEO (or Rank Math) panel → SEO title. Site-wide templates are under Yoast → Settings → Content types.

keyword-targeting.fix: Map each primary keyword to one page and use it in title + H1
keyword-targeting.how: Set the focus keyphrase in Yoast/Rank Math, and use it in the SEO title and the Elementor heading widget (HTML tag H1).

email-domain.fix: Use an address on the site domain, or redirect the old domain to the site

profile-link.fix: Link profiles and add them to schema sameAs

llms.txt.fix: Optional: publish /llms.txt (cheap, low evidence of impact)
llms.txt.how: Yoast (v25+) and Rank Math can generate llms.txt, or upload a file to the web root via SFTP (Cloudways → Application → Access details).

legacy-site: https://www.yuzuhairandbeau.fix: 301-redirect the whole domain to the main site. old Wix site — once yuzu.hair is final, 301 it (page by page) to the matching yuzu.hair URL and keep the domain
legacy-site: https://www.yuzuhairandbeau.how: At the domain host (e.g. One.com / GoDaddy): add a permanent 301 forward of the whole domain to the main site.

legacy-site: https://yuzuhairandbeauty.u.fix: Take it offline (delete the site or the listing on that platform). old ueni site: says West Ealing, 22 Mattock Lane W5 5BH, 07572 107373
legacy-site: https://yuzuhairandbeauty.u.how: ueni: log in at ueni.com → Settings → Delete website (or ask ueni support), then request removal in Google Search Console → Removals if it still shows.
